description: This file defines the interface for the AOTInductor runtime, including data structures, function declarations for creating, managing, and executing model containers and models, handling constants, and stream management, primarily for interoperability across different programming languages via C ABI.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerCreate
methods.description: Creates a model container for multiple models, specifying the number and CPU/GPU usage.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerCreateWithDevice
methods.description: Creates a model container with a specific device string, supporting device and CUDA management.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerDelete
methods.description: Deletes a model container, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerRun
methods.description: Runs inference on the models within the container with specified inputs and outputs.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerRunSingleThreaded
methods.description: Runs inference in a single-threaded mode.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetNumConstants
methods.description: Retrieves the number of constants associated with the model container.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantName
methods.description: Gets the name of a constant by index.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantOriginalFQN
methods.description: Gets the fully qualified original name of a constant.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantFromFolded
methods.description: Indicates if a constant originates from folded constants.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of a constant.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantDtype
methods.description: Gets the data type of a constant.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetConstantDataSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a constant's data.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerExtractConstantsMap
methods.description: Extracts the constants used in the container into a user-provided map.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerUpdateUserManagedConstantBuffer
methods.description: Updates the constant buffer with a user-managed constant map.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerUpdateUserManagedConstantBufferPairs
methods.description: Updates the constant buffer with specific key-value pairs.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerUpdateConstantBuffer
methods.description: Sets up the constant buffer with a provided constant map.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerUpdateInactiveConstantBuffer
methods.description: Prepares the inactive constant buffer with provided constants.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerFreeInactiveConstantBuffer
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the inactive constant buffer.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerRunConstantFolding
methods.description: Performs constant folding optimization on the container.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerSwapConstantBuffer
methods.description: Swaps the active and inactive constant buffers.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetNumInputs
methods.description: Retrieves the number of input tensors for the model.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetInputName
methods.description: Gets the name of an input at a specific index.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetNumOutputs
methods.description: Retrieves the number of output tensors for the model.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetOutputName
methods.description: Gets the name of an output at a specific index.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelCreate
methods.description: Creates a lightweight wrapper for a compiled model, with a constant map.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelRun
methods.description: Executes the model with provided inputs and outputs.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelUpdateConstantsMap
methods.description: Replaces the constant map within a model.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelGetNumOutputs
methods.description: Retrieves the number of outputs of a compiled model.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelContainerGetCallSpec
methods.description: Returns the input and output specification strings for the container.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelDelete
methods.description: Deletes a model instance.

methods.name: AOTInductorModelUpdateConstantsFromBlob
methods.description: Loads model weights from a binary blob.
